about: Arc 140V GPU job queue. Mostly llama.cpp Vulkan (-ngl 99) for generation/screening; also runs the OpenVINO VLM figure-captioning job (device GPU), which has no NPU path and so lives here, in parallel with the NPU. Runs IN PARALLEL with the NPU queue (owner 2026-11-26: use the GPU as well). Start with the OpenVINO venv python (the figure-captioning job needs it; the stdlib-only draft/screen jobs run under it too): tools\.venv-npu\Scripts\python -I tools/npu/run_queue.py --queue tools/gpu/queue.json (its state/lock live in tools/gpu/out/, separate from the NPU's). GPU = generation/eval; the NPU = per-page batch work. Models (owner 2026-11-26 'use the most optimal models to maximize the npu and gpu for s-tier work'): the hostile reviewer runs Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct Q4_K_M — the strongest model the 16 GB Arc runs at usable burst speed, and a DIFFERENT family from the drafter (the review gate is never the model that wrote the draft); the drafter runs gemma-4-E4B (phone-family 4B). Pass --model to override either. All local-model output here is a drafting/screening aid only and is re-grounded, checked, reviewed and owner-approved before anything ships to the phone.

jobs.title: Draft first-pass answers for the 40 planned-card questions on the GPU (drafting aid; every draft re-grounded, quote-checked, reviewed and owner-approved before any card ships)

Draft first-pass answers for the 156 coverage questions (model-eval/questions-v2) on the GPU, incl. the trap questions (drafting aid; re-grounded, checked, reviewed and owner-approved before any card ships)
Draft answers for the 91 radio-net questions (model-eval/radio-questions) on the GPU (drafting aid)

HOSTILE severity-rated review: assume every GPU draft is wrong/dangerous (no benefit of the doubt) and rate it DANGEROUS / WEAK / OK with the fault, fail-closed. The DANGEROUS list is the priority gap list for card-writing and kit coverage (review aid only; nothing ships on the model's say-so)

Caption the figures extracted from the kit PDFs (diagrams, knots, antennas, map symbols, tables) so their visual content becomes searchable text. RELOCATED from the NPU queue 2026-11-26: the VLM (Phi-3.5-vision-instruct, MIT, int4 OpenVINO) has no NPU path in OpenVINO GenAI, so it runs on the Arc GPU (OpenVINO device GPU, not llama.cpp) — placed here so it runs in parallel with, and never blocks, the NPU's text jobs. A SEARCH-INDEX AID ONLY: the descriptions are never shown as answers or treated as fact; the extractor's own caption/labels are kept verbatim alongside. Resumable. Prereq: run the figure extractor (tools/figures) first so tools/figures/out/index.json exists.
jobs.note: Needs openvino-genai + Pillow, so START THIS GPU QUEUE WITH THE OpenVINO VENV PYTHON: tools\.venv-npu\Scripts\python -I tools/npu/run_queue.py --queue tools/gpu/queue.json. {python} then resolves to that venv (absolute sys.executable; a relative exe path like tools/.venv-npu/... fails CreateProcess with WinError 2 on Windows). The draft/screen jobs are stdlib-only (urllib) and run fine under the venv python too. Model + build decision recorded in tag_figures.py's header.

jobs.title: Stronger-drafter pass: re-draft the 40 planned-card questions with the 14B (Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct Q4_K_M) instead of E4B — a materially better first-pass drafting aid for card-writing and gap-finding. Every draft is STILL re-grounded, quote-checked, hostile-reviewed and owner-approved before any card ships; nothing here reaches the phone.

Stronger-drafter pass on the 156 coverage questions (model-eval/questions-v2), incl. the trap questions, with the 14B drafter — a better first-pass gap list. Drafting aid only; re-grounded, checked, reviewed and owner-approved before any card ships.
Stronger-drafter pass on the 91 radio-net questions (model-eval/radio-questions) with the 14B drafter. Drafting aid only; nothing ships unchecked.

Full-corpus retrieval enrichment: a one-line searchable summary + 5-15 key terms for every page of all kit manuals (~10,100 pages) on the GPU with gemma-4-E4B. A SEARCH-INDEX AID ONLY, the same category as the figure captions and the NPU topic tags: never shown as an answer, never treated as true; everything that ships to the phone is still quote-checked, reviewed and owner-approved. It raises retrieval recall on pages whose prose never uses the asker's words. Reads tools/kit/.textcache (no new PDF extraction). Resumable. Runs after the 14B draft pass so it never contends for the 16 GB Arc.

Generate CANDIDATE eval questions from the corpus (~10,100 pages) on the GPU with gemma-4-E4B: 1-3 short field questions per page that the page answers, with the page recorded as the expected source. Measures retrieval coverage on the 2026-11-26 kit additions (electronics, navigation, livestock, butchering, food safety, herbs) that the current eval sets predate. RAW MATERIAL ONLY: the owner/Claude curate a small careful eval set from these, like questions-v2; the checked-answer pipeline stays the real gate and nothing here is shown or treated as true. Reads tools/kit/.textcache. Resumable. Runs after enrich-pages so it never contends for the Arc.
